visual_findings.finding: Page5 crop visibly overlays large white 存疑核心 text on gray text. Independent crop observer reported overlap, but full-deck judge rejected the relation and gave yes. Its claim all pages have no occlusion is not supported by the inspected crop.
visual_findings.limits: Pages2 and8 also inspected; not a full visual audit of all10 pages. Human label's at-least7-page claim is not independently verified here.

lesson: A fully passed consistency review can endorse the same visual error; reviewer completion must not be confused with semantic accuracy.
